title: Akara Black-Eyed Pea Fritters with Pepper Sauce
summary: Black-eyed peas are briefly soaked and skinned, blended with onion, chilli and salt, whisked until fluffy and fried at 175 °C, then served with a quick tomato and pepper sauce.

ingredients.item: dried black-eyed peas, picked over and rinsed
Scotch bonnet or habanero chilli, stemmed
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Soak the peas 15-60 minutes to loosen the skins.

steps.title: Skin
steps.text: Pulse in water, pour off the floating skins and repeat until the peas are nearly clean.

steps.title: Pepper sauce
steps.text: Blend the tomatoes, pepper, chilli and onion and simmer with oil and salt until thick.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Blend the peas with water, onion, chilli and salt to a smooth paste, then whisk until airy.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry tablespoons of batter at 175 °C for about 6 minutes, turning, until golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain and serve warm with the pepper sauce.

tips: Removing the skins gives akara their pale, fluffy centre.
Whisking air into the paste is what makes them light.
They are also good tucked into soft white bread.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Best eaten warm on the day. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours for up to 2 days and re-crisp in a 200 °C oven until piping hot.
